verdict.rationale: Privacy posture and AI-training data use are fair questions for a game engine, since engines can ship cloud services, telemetry or terms of use, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents an AI-training opt-out, a no-training policy, or a statement that the engine collects no user data. The license note that users own the content they create is about copyright, not about training-data use, so it earns no credit.
